measurement_method.content_path: download_wikisource._download_book into scratch; generic cache enabled and initially empty
measurement_method.info_path: PoliteDownloader.get_json allow_cache=False, 50 requested titles across books
measurement_method.transport: One requests.Session, serial, gzip/deflate, original throttle/timeouts/retries/maxlag and User-Agent
measurement_method.compressed_bytes: HTTP response-body bytes read from response.raw before decompression; excludes headers, TLS, and chunk framing
measurement_method.timing_scope: Wall time per request group includes throttle, JSON handling, scratch recording and raw-book writing/comparison; excludes parsing/products. Groups share one downloader so a group can include its initial inter-request throttle.
limitations: Current title-content responses omit revision IDs; later info IDs cannot seed metadata for those responses.
Only the exact-revision probe and direct-content-with-IDs probe establish paired IDs/text, for their measured subsets.
No incremental implementation or production speedup is measured in Phase 1.
Elapsed time is a single run with the original random throttle; do not infer a fixed speedup.
